ruleBookInfo.wordCount:
<js>
let id = book.bookUrl.match(/_(\d+)\/?$/)[1];
result = java.ajax(
	 `https://www.xiaoxiaoshuo8.com/modules/article/52mb_uptime.php?id=${id}&type=lastupdate`
).match(/\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}/)[0]+'更新';
</js>

ruleExplore.coverUrl: <js>var href = java.getString('a@href'); var p = href.lastIndexOf('/'); var id = href.substring(0,p); var q = id.lastIndexOf('_'); var a = id.substring(id.lastIndexOf('/')+1,q); var b = id.substring(q+1); result = 'https://www.xiaoxiaoshuo8.com/files/article/image/' + a + '/' + b + '/' + b + 's.jpg';</js>
ruleExplore.name: a@text
